text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wooww~ A pair of tickets to watch a soccer 
match?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A birthday present from me! Happy 
birthday, Yuki-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank ya kindly...! But ya see, I haven't 
really been to places like this much.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I hope I don't do anything rude...? If 
there's any proper etiquette, please teach 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, there are certainly a few rules you 
should probably follow, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's have fun! That's 
the most important rule of etiquette!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all to support Yuki-chan 
so she can have the absolute most fun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... all that anxiety I felt just 
totally flew away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm, umm. ...I'm so excited! To watch 
soccer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...! Yeah, yeah! I'm looking forward to 
it toooooo!!"
